{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the raw data again for '999999.99' in revenue
print("Raw revenue value counts:")
print(df['revenue'].value_counts().head(10))

# Now, explicitly filter out rows where revenue is '999999.99'
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Check the shape again
print(f"\nShape after filtering: {df_clean.shape}")

# Check if any '999999.99' remain
remaining_qa = df_clean[df_clean['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of remaining QA rows: {len(remaining_qa)}")

# Print the first few rows to verify
print("\nFirst few rows of clean data:")
print(df_clean.head())"}
